articles.title: ‘No case against me anywhere,’ Lalit Modi to TOI after getting British citizenship
articles.summary: IPL founder Lalit Modi, who left India in 2010 amid allegations of tax evasion, money laundering and proxy ownership linked to IPL, has announced he has received British citizenship. Lalit was appearing at an event at Oxford Union when he made the announcement..

articles.summary: BJP condemned Congress party leader Devendra Yadav for allegedly polluting the Yamuna River during Chhath Puja. The BJP accused Congress of disrespecting the faith of Chhath devotees amidst environmental concerns.

articles.title: 103-year-old D-Day veteran receives replacement medals 80 years after returning his uniform
articles.summary: Douglas Halley, a 103-year-old D-Day veteran, recently received his wartime medals which were lost in 1945. A young historian, Joseph Smith, discovered Halley's military record while researching veterans' stories and assisted in recovering the medals.

articles.title: Man finds centuries-old gold ring after 15 minutes of metal detecting
articles.summary: Kevin Short found a centuries-old gold ring inscribed “I live in hope” just 15 minutes into a metal-detecting search in Warwickshire. Authenticated by the British Museum, the 16th-to-18th-century ring is expected to fetch up to £3,000 at a December 2 auction..

articles.summary: More than 28 cyclists participated in the eighth annual Turkey Ride to deliver Thanksgiving turkeys. They gathered at Maine Sport Rockport and picked up items from Hannaford Supermarkets.

articles.title: Is AI widening the gender gap at work? Pew Research finds women's employment growth lagging behind men's in AI-exposed jobs
articles.summary: A Pew Research Center analysis has highlighted an emerging gender divide in the US labour market, with women's employment growth lagging behind men's in occupations more exposed to artificial intelligence. The findings reveal sharper disparities among workers without bachelor's degrees, raising concerns about automation, occupational inequality and women's future employment prospects..

articles.title: INSPIRE-SHE scholarship 2026: Government invites applications for 12,000 students; check eligibility and benefits
articles.summary: Eligible students are invited to apply for the INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education through the official website. Applications will be accepted from November 7, 2026, to December 7, 2026, specifically for meritorious students.

articles.title: US universities oppose proposed $70,000 OPT fee: Could Indian students lose post-study work opportunities?
articles.summary: The US Department of Homeland Security has proposed a $70,000 fee for an initial Optional Practical Training recommendation and $30,000 for subsequent recommendations for an international student. The fee would be payable by the institution recommending OPT, not directly by the student under the proposal.

articles.title: New Zealand extends post-study work visa to four years for Indian PhD graduates from today; check details here
articles.summary: New Zealand will extend post-study work visa eligibility to up to four years for Indian PhD graduates from November 16, 2026, under the India–New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA). The agreement also provides up to two years for bachelor's graduates and three years for master's graduates, subject to eligibility requirements.

articles.title: Gracie Abrams to tour in Australia next year
articles.summary: Gracie Abrams has officially confirmed her upcoming tour in Australia for the year 2027, featuring six performances. She will perform three shows at Melbourne's Rod Laver Arena and three at Sydney’s Afterpay Arena.

articles.summary: Phil Collins celebrated his induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame alongside his children and family. He expressed gratitude during his acceptance speech while acknowledging the support of others throughout his career.
